## Experience

### Senior Flutter Developer — Document Scanner & PDF Editor (contract)
Sep 2026 — Oct 2026

- Owned the mobile track without a dedicated PM: architecture, backlog prioritization, release plan and direct client communication.
- Joined a project stuck before release: audited the codebase, documented the architecture and shipped the app to the App Store and Google Play in 1.5 months.
- Built the release plan, estimated tasks in hours, tracked work in Trello and Hubstaff, sent the client regular status updates.
- Wrote architecture and build documentation so the project can be handed over to another developer in a day.
- Added monitoring and attribution: Firebase Crashlytics and Adjust (neither was in place).

### Senior Flutter Developer — ProveUp — fitness battles & freestyle football (contract)
May 2026 — Sep 2026

- Tasks in Linear, syncs with the PM and client, code delivery to the client per an agreed process (semver, runbook).
- Distributed team (client, PM, backend, design): demos, reviews, status updates, API alignment.
- Made the case to the client for StoreKit and Google Play Billing over Stripe for virtual goods (store rules).
- Two builds from one codebase (prod / legacy flavors), migration to a new Apple developer account, manual code signing, TestFlight (internal and external beta).

### Senior Flutter Developer — Healthy4u — AI health assistant (product startup)
Jun 2025 — Sep 2026

- Owned the mobile product end to end: feature estimates, roadmap, release cycle, syncs with the founder, designer and backend.
- 1.5 years on an ML product team: specs and API contracts for the backend, took part in RAG and LLM-pipeline architecture discussions.
- Rewrote the app from scratch (previously iOS-only native Swift) and shipped it to the App Store and Google Play; sole mobile developer for 15 months: regular releases, Clean Architecture, TDD.
- Several App Store and Google Play review cycles; resolved Guideline 1.4.1 and 3.1.2(c) rejections.
- When something breaks on the server, I bring the backend a report with logs and expected behavior instead of waiting.

### Flutter Developer & Project Manager — forYou Inc — Agrotook marketplace
Oct 2024 — May 2025
